title: Tool Adapters & Specs
summary: This module provides adapters for integrating various external systems and data sources as CrewAI tools, alongside a utility for extracting detailed specifications from these tools.

nodes.label: Adapt Enterprise Actions
nodes.title: Enterprise Action Kit Adapter
nodes.description: Converts definitions from an external enterprise API into CrewAI BaseTool instances, enabling agents to use enterprise-specific functionalities.

nodes.label: Manage LanceDB
nodes.title: LanceDB Adapter
nodes.description: Provides an interface for interacting with LanceDB, a local vector database, allowing for vector-based queries and data addition.

nodes.label: Manage RAG Knowledge Base
nodes.title: RAG Adapter
nodes.description: Facilitates interaction with a Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) system, enabling agents to query and add information to a knowledge base.

nodes.label: Extract Tool Specifications
nodes.title: Tool Specification Extractor
nodes.description: Analyzes CrewAI BaseTool classes to extract their detailed specifications, including parameters, environment variables, and dependencies, for documentation or dynamic loading.

nodes.label: Enterprise Action API
nodes.title: External Enterprise API
nodes.description: An external API providing definitions and execution capabilities for enterprise-specific actions, accessed by the EnterpriseActionKitToolAdapter.

nodes.label: LanceDB Vector Store
nodes.title: LanceDB Vector Database
nodes.description: A local vector database used for efficient similarity search and storage of embedded data, managed by the LanceDBAdapter.

nodes.label: RAG System
nodes.title: Retrieval Augmented Generation System
nodes.description: An internal or external system responsible for Retrieval Augmented Generation, providing contextual information to agents via the RAGAdapter.

nodes.label: CrewAI BaseTool Classes
nodes.title: CrewAI BaseTool Definitions
nodes.description: The foundational classes for all tools within the CrewAI ecosystem, providing a standardized interface for agent capabilities, analyzed by the ToolSpecExtractor.

nodes.label: Tool Specifications Output
nodes.title: Generated Tool Specs (JSON)
nodes.description: Structured JSON output containing detailed specifications for various CrewAI tools, generated by the ToolSpecExtractor for documentation or dynamic use.

groups.label: Tool Adapters
groups.title: Tool Integration Adapters
groups.description: Components responsible for integrating and abstracting interactions with various external systems and data sources as CrewAI tools.

groups.label: Tool Specification
groups.title: Tool Specification Management
groups.description: Handles the extraction and generation of structured metadata for CrewAI tools, crucial for documentation, discovery, and dynamic loading.
